name: Fudo-Mae
tagline: Shibuya in 14 minutes and Shinagawa in 15 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, where Tokyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 21 minutes to Otemachi, 23 minutes to Shinjuku, 14 minutes to Shibuya and 15 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. The station stands 5.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 18.3 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 5.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4 m to 22.3 m, a difference of 18.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 1 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The station itself is inside the projected area, but few of the points around it are. Compared with other stations in the 23 wards, the flood projection here is on the small side.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 4 clinics and 6 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 青葉会五反田神経内科病院, about 2 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 有仁会阿部病院, about 17 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Meguro Line.
congestion: Tokyu Meguro Line runs at 133% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 不動前→目黒, which includes this station. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000 and 2LDK ¥310,000 to ¥320,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. What holds the figure down: only one line, the {line}, serving the station. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Meguro; for lower rent, Fudo-Mae.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Fudo-Mae. Both have the Tokyu Meguro Line. Meguro also has the JR Yamanote Line, Tokyo Metro Namboku Line and Toei Mita Line, which Fudo-Mae does not. Meguro is at least 7 minutes quicker to Shinjuku and Shinagawa. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥19,000 more at Meguro.

neighbours.lead: Fudo-Mae is ahead on how close the centre is, and little else separates the two.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Fudo-Mae. Fudo-Mae adds the Tokyu Meguro Line; Osaki-Hirokoji adds the Tokyu Ikegami Line. Fudo-Mae is at least 6 minutes quicker to Otemachi and Roppongi. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

goodFor: People who want to finish their shopping on foot
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: The 首都高速2号目黒線 viaduct runs a short walk from the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
山手通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 11 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Meguro Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the low side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: This station sits on the busiest stretch of the Tokyu Meguro Line, but at 133% passengers are not shoulder to shoulder.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
